unit: Office of the Vice Chancellor (Graduate & Undergraduate Education, GUE / DUE)
best_contact_title: Director of Finance and Administration (GUE Headquarters)
why_this_contact: GUE DAF; handles internal fund transfers. Edgerton Center reports into this office, so the ask is best framed through Edgerton/Chris Mayer first.
alt_contact_title: Senior Financial Administrator / Financial Officer, Office of the Vice Chancellor
head_title: Vice Chancellor for Graduate and Undergraduate Education
fit_reason: Edgerton Center (Spokes home) sits under this office; K-12 STEM and experiential learning mission; Edgerton gave $5,000 in 2026.
notes: No 2026-list contact for this office. Vice Chancellor title changed: Darmofal named Feb 2025. GUE leadership also includes Kate Trimble (OEL), Janet Rankin (TLL), Deborah Liverman (CAPD), Denzil Streete (OGE).

best_contact_title: Chief of Staff and Senior Associate Dean/Director, Office of Experiential Learning
why_this_contact: Leads OEL; Edgerton Center and PKG are affiliated centers; Spokes is a hands-on experiential learning opportunity.
fit_reason: Mission fit (experiential learning, Edgerton affiliated) but its money flows as faculty/DLC-submitted proposals, not student group gifts.
notes: Social Impact ELO Initiative solicits proposals from MIT faculty/staff (DLCs); eligibility questions go to oel@mit.edu. Possible route: Edgerton faculty/staff submit on Spokes behalf. Phone from 2022-23 materials.

unit: Priscilla King Gray Center for Social Impact (PKG Center)
why_this_contact: Director; no individual email seen on the team page, use pkgcenter@mit.edu.
fit_reason: Public service mission; funds student-designed service projects (PKG Fellowships, IDEAS Social Innovation Incubator grants $1,000-$20,000, Projects for Peace).
notes: Other staff: Alison Hynd (Assistant Dean), Cassandra Goodman (Admin & Program Assistant). Fellowship/IDEAS deadlines not visible on fetched pages (IDEAS page says applications open; check the event page). Past cycles: summer fellowship deadline in March. Room W20-549.

best_contact_title: Director of Administration and Finance, Division of Student Life
why_this_contact: DSL DAF per EVPT list.
alt_contact_title: Financial Officer, Dean for Student Life Administration
head_title: Vice Chancellor for Student Life (started Oct 19, 2026; succeeded Suzy Nelson)
fit_reason: DSL funds student groups through SOLE/SGFC (see separate rows), not departmental gifts; new vice chancellor just arrived.
notes: Head email not seen on a page. DSL Finance and SOLE handle student org money.

unit: Student Organizations, Leadership and Engagement (SOLE) and Student Group Funding Council (SGFC)
why_this_contact: Distributes One Fund money to ASA-recognized groups, club sports, FSILGs, residence governments; replaced UA Finboard and GSC Funding Board for group funding.
fit_reason: Real money, but Spokes is run through the Edgerton Center; eligibility of Edgerton-run teams is unconfirmed (only ASA-recognized groups listed). Ask SGFC before applying.
notes: Cycles reported: spring, summer, fall (fall 2025 deadline Aug 15; allocations Aug 29). 2026-27 dates not found. Sloan groups not eligible. Gifts-in-kind: notify sole@mit.edu. Sponsorships need approval 30 working days ahead (sole-finances@mit.edu). Donations: alumni gifts under $2,000 go via the Alumni Association (aa-students-services@mit.edu), over $2,000 via RSO; groups must first complete the Giving Page Setup Request Form.

why_this_contact: UA page says Finboard is deactivated; group funding moved to SGFC. Travel grants handled by UA Grants Chair.
fit_reason: Only ASA-recognized, majority-undergraduate groups; no evidence Edgerton teams qualify; deactivated.
notes: Old cycles: Winter Jan-Mar, Spring Apr-Jun, Summer Jul-Sep, Fall Oct-Dec. Funds are reimbursement only.

why_this_contact: GSC Funding Board group funding is now through SGFC. GSC still runs Professional Development Exploration Grant, Sustainability Fund, DEI Community Fund; OGE runs Graduate Student Experience Grants.
fit_reason: Mostly grad-student group/individual funds; Edgerton team eligibility unknown. Sustainability Fund may suit the cycling/climate angle.
notes: No GSC officer email seen on fetched pages. Amounts/deadlines not listed.
